premises.text: Privacy regulation and fines make getting usable data for AI slow (privacy engineering, legal, security)
premises.evidence_span: It takes a long time to get access to data. Data is either locked away, or they have to go through a long process, including privacy engineering, legal, and security

premises.text: Platform converts private real data into anonymized synthetic data with the same properties
premises.evidence_span: We convert private real data into 100% anonymized synthetic data that has the same properties as the real data

premises.text: Confidential computing lets jobs run on encrypted data so BetterData cannot see customer data
premises.evidence_span: We introduced confidential computing, where you can compute on encrypted data, so companies don't have to trust us with data because we can't even see it

premises.text: Data tokenization keeps companies owning data with tamper-proof access locks
premises.evidence_span: data tokenization. Companies own their data fully, and we have tamper-proof locks for that as well

premises.text: Encrypted multi-party collaboration can combine datasets and return joint synthetic data
premises.evidence_span: companies can collaborate on data sets together and understand more about their combined and common customers, all while the data remains encrypted for all parties involved

premises.text: Licensing/support model supports on-prem, private, and public cloud via APIs or web UI
premises.evidence_span: We have a licensing and support business model, and we support on-premise, private, and public cloud

domains.name: Synthetic data with confidential compute and tokenization

value.text: Innovate on data in days while protecting customer privacy
value.evidence_span: allows you to innovate on data in days and not months

causal_links.evidence_span: data privacy to be the biggest challenge for companies to build AI software today
access data in days and not months, retain full ownership over their data, and safely collaborate with others
use our APIs integrated directly into your data science pipelines or the web interface

notes: QA report similarity to real-data model performance folded into synthetic-data mechanism. Pilots and NUS grants excluded as traction. Singleton D1 and D3 retained as separately revisable problem framing and commercial packaging.
